response.text: {"queries":[],"result_json":"{\"reviews\":[{\"actor\":\"wren\",\"decision\":\"develop\",\"ability\":null,\"reason\":\"Develop a general air-exposure food-preservation trial, including an equipment-free whole-food mode, in the current-conversation development handoff. The supplied related-capability searches and exact records show that gather transfers material, probe performs small observations or tests, and consult reads records; none implements a continuing preservation process. Search coverage is incomplete and the query budget is exhausted, so the handoff must check the remaining registry and reuse any equivalent handler before adding code. Mild spring conditions and edible roots do not establish that whole roots can dry sufficiently or safely. A real, potentially unsuccessful ventilation/drying trial is a feasible precursor; neither a guaranteed preserved product nor free equipment is justified.\",\"specification\":\"General operation: air-exposure preservation trial, parameterized by owned food stack ID, quantity, accessible placement location or existing support ID, and start/inspect/turn/stop mode. It is not specific to wren or roots. Minimum executable mode exposes intact food to actual local conditions; it does not imply cutting, cooking, firemaking, sterilization, construction or access to salt. Reuse and record foundation-forest@1 forest.gather for any separately gathered material, base navigation and ownership transfers where applicable, and foundation-open@1 open.probe for eligible observations. Do not relabel those functions as new inventions. Implement the missing persistent processing state and its integration with food decay in code, not through repeated reviewer decisions.\\nReferences and prerequisites: the currently supplied eligible input is item-5-wren-49, resource root, quantity 3, owner wren, harvestedAt 5. Tick-10 decay is 6.38045589; the applicant's tick-9 figure 5.28331244 is stale and must not reset the input. Resolve and revalidate the exact stack at execution, including intervening consumption or deterioration. Known root nutrition 14 and toxicity 0 are starting food facts, not certification of processed-food safety. Require personal study, ownership of the selected quantity, reach of the placement, sufficient energy, and a physically usable location. Whole-food mode requires no tool or fuel. It may use an accessible existing surface only after checking its actual suitability; direct-ground exposure must retain ground contact, contamination and weather risks rather than treating bare ground as a clean rack. A support is optional, but if selected must really exist and be lawfully usable. The mentioned fallen branches are not owned inventory and cannot be consumed or turned into equipment by this operation. If no usable placement is available, return a concrete precondition failure without creating a site or changing food.\\nCosts and progress: starting or relocating a batch takes one active simulation round and 1 + 0.5 times selected food units energy; charge actual movement separately through the existing movement operation, not twice. No food is deliberately consumed by intact-food setup. Inspection or turning takes one round and 0.2 energy; separately requested destructive probes retain probe's 0.1 material-unit and 0.5 energy costs instead. Passive exposure requires actual elapsed world rounds and has no remote labor or recurring actor-energy charge. There is no promised completion time: report elapsed rounds and measured progress each inspection, and quote any estimated duration as conditional on the implemented environment model. A small comparison can reserve one intact root in its ordinary handling condition and expose one intact root, leaving the third untouched; reserve and track both real inputs separately. The control is optional, is not extra stock, and decays normally.\\nMechanism and dependencies: before execution, the handoff must supply an explicit deterministic environmental drying/rewetting and contamination update integrated with the existing decay handler, using actual temperature, moisture/humidity, airflow, precipitation, contact and food properties where modeled. Do not infer dry air from mild spring weather or reveal unobserved environmental/resource fields. Bind the update coefficients, supported food classes, measurement precision, and any sufficient-dryness safety threshold in the executable contract. Where required properties are unavailable, implement the precursor as tracked intact-food exposure and decay comparison with preservation status unverified; do not invent water loss, shelf-life extension or safety. At each real world update, retain prior decay and add the nonnegative decay increment prescribed for the actual food state. Only a supported drying mechanism may lower future increments relative to otherwise matching ordinary storage; never erase prior spoilage. Rewetting and adverse conditions can reverse drying progress or worsen deterioration. No universal whole-root drying guarantee is permitted.\\nConservation and effects: reserve selected food without duplicating it, recording provenance, quantity, initial decay and any represented mass/water state. On release, surviving food is the same batch or an explicitly linked processed output, not an additional batch. If drying is supported, lost water leaves as an environmental output; edible solids and nutrients are conserved except for explicitly accounted decay, contamination or processing losses. Never multiply nutrition because water mass fell. Apply existing spoilage/discard rules to ruined portions with explicit waste outputs. Air exposure does not detoxify or sterilize food. Preserve the root's ordinary nutrition handling, apply any demonstrated changes through the food model, and label unverified safety as unverified rather than silently assigning zero added hazard. Report actual decay changes, elapsed time, input/output amounts, water change when measurable, and any evidenced nutritional or safety changes. A controlled comparison uses both actual trajectories, with differences in location and handling disclosed; it does not fabricate a hypothetical control observation.\\nLifecycle and maintenance: persist batch IDs, placement, progress, consumed effort, observations and last update tick. Interruption of active work retains completed placement and physical state; resume revalidates the same batch and charges only remaining work. Any passive exposed batch continues normal environmental processing while the actor does something else. Inspection and optional turning require actual actor action; weather response and protection are not automatic. Stop ends managed exposure, not ordinary spoilage, and returns or leaves the surviving batch according to actual ownership, reach and placement. Cancellation releases unconsumed reservations exactly once; elapsed time, spent energy, lost water, spoilage, destructive samples and consumed materials are never refunded. Death stops the actor's work and releases project locks under existing death/ownership rules, without teleporting food or undoing exposure; physical food continues to deteriorate. Development/review waiting advances neither world time nor processing. The product is a traceable exposed-food batch with recorded outcomes, and only becomes labeled successfully preserved when the implemented criteria have actually been met.\",\"learning\":2,\"experienceReview\":\"No pleasure or satisfaction is awarded for requesting, registration, learning, starting a timer, inspection clicks or a success label. If the existing experience engine supports it, a genuinely informative measured outcome, including failed drying or faster spoilage, may qualify for verified information gain only when measurements support a personally applicable new conclusion. Deduplicate equivalent observations and overlapping probe/trial claims by actor, batch, tested relation and evidence interval. This development proposes no new reward grant, account, budget, goal or permission change; use only already authorized bounded experience rules with their existing caps, cooldowns and decay. Repeated legitimate hands-on maintenance may count only under existing modest practice rules, not as unlimited novelty. Do not grant physical comfort from food placement; the comfort ceiling remains 10. Eating continues to supply basic nutrition independently of mood.\",\"visualReview\":\"Emit observable, reusable events for actual placement, inspection, turning, environmental damage, removal, interruption and verified outcome, each carrying actor when applicable, exact batch and location references, mode, tick, progress state and publicly observable changes. Provide reusable food-batch visual metadata: component, resource appearance, placement/support, intact or altered form, exposed/in-progress/interrupted/removed/spoiled state, and visible surface changes only when supported. Keep analytical decay readings and uncertainty in the inspection report rather than pretending that a precise hidden value is visible. Do not show slices, smoke, racks, dryness, safety badges or preserved-food completion art without the corresponding real process and evidence. An incomplete, unsupported or failed trial must remain visibly pending, unverified or failed, never display preservation success. Observation events alone do not authorize experience rewards.\"}]}"}
